description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyNotModifiableException' used within a policy management context in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class is immutable, serializable, and provides static factory methods and a builder to instantiate the exception with detailed context information. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'PolicyException', encapsulating the case where a policy cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions.

classes.name: PolicyNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom immutable exception class indicating a policy could not be modified due to insufficient permissions. Provides static factory methods, JSON parsing capabilities, and a nested builder class.
